answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to carry a cipher-signed record of a completed voyage of useful work: tasks delivered, payments settled, disputes resolved. Newcomers start in a karst of probationary roles where the ground is thin — they can earn, but only small amounts, until a reputation aquifer builds. Forging ten fake identities means ten separate voyages of real work, which costs the attacker more than the attack can gain.
